title: Heavenly Tribulation
summary: Mo Yun brings Qiu Siping, a late Core Formation cultivator who recognises the ancient restriction, and he uses a monster to lure out the man who set it. Qiu Siping offers Wang Lin a deal: his master and senior brother, both newly at Nascent Soul, lie helpless in an ancient cave full of restrictions, and devouring a Nascent Soul greatly helps one break through. Wang Lin sees through the cave's giant python, whose own spirit power holds the formation up, opens it, and each of them takes a Nascent Soul. Refining his first restriction flag calls down a Heavenly Tribulation that nearly shatters his golden core, and cultivators who rush in for the 'ancient treasure', led by a Nascent Soul expert, are wiped out by his divine sense. He ends at Core Formation great perfection with a false Nascent Soul, but learns that the Ji Realm will stop him from ever going past Nascent Soul, and refuses to accept it.
events: Qiu Siping tries to lift Mo Yun's restriction and lures Wang Lin out

introduced: Ji Realm (named as the cap on his cultivation)
cultivation: Qiu Siping: late Core Formation; his master early Nascent Soul, his senior brother just reached Nascent Soul. Wang Lin: Core Formation great perfection with a false Nascent Soul; because of the Ji Realm he can go no higher than Nascent Soul.
changes: Official English says 'True Spirit Realm' for Nascent Soul and 'Extreme conditions' for the Ji Realm.
flags: What happens to Mo Yun is not clearly stated (AK 218-240); the wiki says she is killed here.
Who explains that the Ji Realm caps him at Nascent Soul (AK 1101) is not clear; likely Xu Liguo.
